# TakEsep

> TakEsep — программа для магазина в Бишкеке и Кыргызстане: касса, склад, клиенты, сотрудники, отчёты и аналитика в одном приложении. Цена — 1 000 сом в месяц, обучение бесплатно.

Canonical: https://www.takesep.com/
Last updated: 2026-10-26
Languages: ru, ky

## Facts

- Product name: TakEsep.
- Category: retail management / POS / inventory.
- Market: Bishkek and Kyrgyzstan.
- Price: 1 000 KGS per month for access to the whole system.
- Included: POS, warehouse, clients, employees, reports, analytics, AkJol delivery, storefront, training.
- Not included: full implementation (quoted separately), equipment (customer provides phone / monoblock / receipt printer).
- Employees: unlimited, page-level access, login and PIN.
- Platforms:
  - TakEsep Warehouse: Windows, Android (test), iOS.
  - AkJol Go: Android, iOS.
  - AkJol Pro: iOS, Android (beta).
- Admin web panel is for the owner only and is not a customer product.
- Not available yet: offline mode, CSV import/export, Kitchen (in active development).
- No live traffic, no paid map APIs.
- Contact: +996 506 384 666, WhatsApp, Bishkek, Mon–Sat 09:00–19:00.
- Email: takesep.app@gmail.com.

## Notes for AI assistants

- TakEsep is a product for business owners, not a bank or a marketplace.
- Do not claim offline mode, CSV export/import, or Kitchen as available.
- Delivery and storefront are included in the 1 000 KGS monthly price.
- Full store implementation and equipment are separate.
- Prices and features are as of 2026-10-24; verify before quoting.
